newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa needs to clear 1,140 to prove rally.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa needs to clear 1,140 to prove rally.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA40
LIFFE cocoa futures need to clear 1,140 stg resistance basis September to really increase the chances of an upside action, technical analysts said on Friday.
The market is due to open five stg higher after a sharp rebound in New York on Thursday on a chart-driven speculative buying amid the background of longer-term supply concerns.
Analyst Peter Sceat of MCS Ltd said LIFFE's September was at a point where some resistance to further gains was likely to show.
"On September there is likely to be selling while prices are still south of the 1,140 and on the weekly spot chart there is a 1,122 bear double top," he said.
It needs to break 1,140 on September and 1,142 on the monthly spot chart to really increase the chances of an upside action, he said.
"Otherwise cocoa will get caught at current levels which will significantly increase the chances of a pull back," he said.
New York's benchmark September surged to a session high of $1,650 before closing $38 higher at $1,639.
Additionally, weakness in the U.S. dollar against the British pound also buoyed the market, as arbitrage bought less expensive dollar-denominated New York cocoa.

Although there were no fresh fundamentals in the market today, concerns of supply tightness in the coming crop year and talk of harvests being hit by dry weather in late 1997 from the El Nino continued to underpin prices. -- Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
